dialogues.jp: 夜の夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I dreamed of that night.
dialogues.text: I dreamed of that night.

dialogues.jp: ただ深い――
dialogues.en: It was deep---
dialogues.text: It was deep---

dialogues.jp: 真っ暗な――
dialogues.en: Dark-----
dialogues.text: Dark-----

dialogues.jp:
桜の匂いがあまりにも強すぎて、全てを乱れさ
せるような。
dialogues.en:
The scent of cherry trees was so strong it made me
disorientated.
dialogues.text:
The scent of cherry trees was so strong it made me
disorientated.

dialogues.jp: 桜。
dialogues.en: The cherry tree.
dialogues.text: The cherry tree.

dialogues.jp: 桜の夢を見ていた。
dialogues.en: I was dreaming of the cherry tree.
dialogues.text: I was dreaming of the cherry tree.

dialogues.jp: 狂ったように、月夜の中で赤く咲く桜を。
dialogues.en: It was blossoming like crazy in the light of the moon.
dialogues.text: It was blossoming like crazy in the light of the moon.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「彼女の想いはココに｛たど／辿｝り着いてしまった」
dialogues.en: "Her thoughts came to me."
dialogues.text: "Her thoughts came to me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「すでに｛・・・・・・・・・・／終わりが始まっている｝」
dialogues.en: "The end is near."
dialogues.text: "The end is near."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「小川にダムの水が流れ込むのと同じように、
　ただ、上も下もなく溢れ返る」
dialogues.en: "It will overflow like a stream going into a dam."
dialogues.text: "It will overflow like a stream going into a dam."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「彼女のせいではない……が、想いの強さが諸
　刃となった」
dialogues.en:
"It's not her fault. But, the power of her will shall become
an ultimatum."
dialogues.text:
"It's not her fault. But, the power of her will shall become
an ultimatum."

dialogues.jp: 歌うような声がする。
dialogues.en: It sounds like someone is singing.
dialogues.text: It sounds like someone is singing.

dialogues.jp:
こんな夢だとしか思えない世界で、それは強固
な意志をもって響いた。
dialogues.en: It sounded real, in this world of my dream.
dialogues.text: It sounded real, in this world of my dream.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なぜ桜がこんなにきれいな赤色をしているか
　と｛たず／訊｝ねられたら――こう答えよう」
dialogues.en:
"If someone asks me why it is that the blossom on the cherry
trees are so red, I shall tell them......"
dialogues.text:
"If someone asks me why it is that the blossom on the cherry
trees are so red, I shall tell them......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「桜の下には死体が埋まっていて――」
dialogues.en: "There is a dead body under the cherry tree......"
dialogues.text: "There is a dead body under the cherry tree......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「その血を吸い上げているから、桜の花びらは
　赤く咲くんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"And the trees suck blood out of it to make their blossom
red."
dialogues.text:
"And the trees suck blood out of it to make their blossom
red."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちゅーちゅー」
dialogues.en: Sakura squeaked like a mouse.
dialogues.text: Sakura squeaked like a mouse.

dialogues.jp: ◆ちゅーちゅーな夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆The dream with lots of kisses◆
dialogues.text: ◆The dream with lots of kisses◆

dialogues.jp: 音のない世界――桜の夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I dreamed of the cherry tree in a silent world.
dialogues.text: I dreamed of the cherry tree in a silent world.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの姿をしたナニカが、音夢がどこかへと、
たどり着いてしまったと呟いた。
dialogues.en: The cherry tree mumbled that Nemu has gone somewhere.
dialogues.text: The cherry tree mumbled that Nemu has gone somewhere.
